scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @catlas/atlas-react && npm run build -w @catlas/ui-graph-evaluator && npm run build -w @catlas/atlas-benchmarks
scripts.test: npm run test -w @catlas/ui-graph-evaluator && npm run test -w @catlas/atlas-benchmarks && npm run test -w @catlas/atlas-react && npm run test -w @catlas/semantic-atlas
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @catlas/atlas-react && npm run typecheck -w @catlas/semantic-atlas
scripts.validate: npm run build:packages && npm test && npm run typecheck
scripts.validate:example: npm run build:packages && npm run example:atlas-consumer:build && npm run bench:ui -- --url=http://127.0.0.1:4173 --gate
scripts.validate:atlas: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @catlas/semantic-atlas && npm run quick -w @catlas/atlas-benchmarks -- --profile quick --gate
